title: Jacob Rodriguez is Defensive Rookie of the Year favorite after big game vs. Chiefs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jacob Rodriguez is Defensive Rookie of the Year favorite after big game vs. Chiefs
sources.description: As a linebacker at Texas Tech last season, linebacker Jacob Rodriguez as a unanimous All-American, and his long list of honors included the Bronko Nagurski Trophy and Chuck Bednarik Award, both of which recognize the best defensive player in the country, as well as receiving the most Heisman Trophy votes of any defensive player.
